message: `AutomationDefinition.disableConditions` supports `afterRuns` (`max`) and `afterDate` (`date`) rules combined with logical OR, with at most one condition per kind. Host-owned `AutomationEntry.runCount` tracks the current scheduled-run allowance. Edit conditions through `automation/updateRequested`: omission leaves them unchanged, an array replaces them, and `[]` removes all conditions without re-enabling the automation.
